While State Street has long supported clients in Saudi Arabia through its global platform and existing capabilities in the Kingdom, the addition of the operating funds component of the MIOF license facilitates the firm to formally offer fund administration services locally, creating a fully integrated end-to-end investment servicing model in Saudi Arabia.
